lines.en: Good morning! Do you exercise here every day?
Yes, I walk here every morning. And you?
lines.ko: 네, 매일 아침 여기서 걸어요. 당신은요?

lines.en: I walked here yesterday for the first time.
Great! Let's stretch first and walk together.
Should we walk fast or slow?
Slowly at first. Breathe deep and move your arms.
lines.ko: 처음엔 천천히요. 깊게 숨 쉬고 팔을 움직여요.

lines.en: I can't run, but I can walk well.
That's fine. Walking is good exercise too.
Will you meet me here tomorrow morning?
lines.ko: 내일 아침에도 여기서 만나 줄 거예요?

lines.en: Yes, I will. We will walk to the river.
Grandma, let's play ball! Can you catch?
Yes, I can. But throw it slowly, please.
lines.ko: 네, 할 수 있어요. 그래도 천천히 던져 줘요.

lines.en: Okay. Here it comes!
Good throw! Now move back and run a little.
lines.ko: 잘 던졌어요! 이제 뒤로 가서 조금 달려 봐요.

lines.en: Last week I ran fast at school.
Great! Can you run and catch the ball?
lines.ko: 와! 달리면서 공을 잡을 수 있어요?

lines.en: Yes! Throw it high, Grandma.
Here it goes. Breathe slowly and watch the ball.
lines.ko: 갑니다. 천천히 숨 쉬고 공을 잘 봐요.

lines.en: I got it! Will we play again after lunch?
lines.ko: 잡았어요! 점심 먹고 또 놀 거예요?

lines.en: Yes, we will. Let's stretch and rest now.
